title: 凯雷集团大卫·鲁宾斯坦：人工智能泡沫不会破裂但巨额投入回报存疑
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: As a business owner, someone in markets, are you getting concerned about valuations getting ahead of how quickly we can deploy some of this technology in productive ways?
segments.zh: 作为企业主或市场参与者，你是否担心估值增长快于技术实际部署的速度？

segments.en: An enormous amount of money is now going into AI and going into data centers.
segments.zh: 巨额资金正涌入AI和数据中心。

segments.en: And the theory behind investing is you get your money back with a return.
segments.zh: **的基本逻辑是收回本金并获得回报。

segments.en: Whether you will get your money back with a reasonable return on all the AI investments is unclear at this point because so much money is going into this area
segments.zh: 目前尚不清楚所有AI**能否带来合理回报，因为资金涌入过多，

segments.en: and it's not clear when the returns will come back if at all.
segments.zh: 且回报何时到来、甚至能否到来都不明确。

segments.en: So I do think there's reason for caution but I don't think it's a concern right now that AI will be a bubble that will burst dramatically.
segments.zh: 因此我认为需要谨慎，但我不认为AI会形成剧烈破裂的泡沫。

segments.en: I do think there's a lot of interest in AI and I think for some time you're going to see a lot of investment dollars going into it.
segments.zh: AI确实吸引大量关注，未来一段时间仍会有大量**涌入。

segments.en: And I think a lot of them are justified because AI is clearly going to change the way we live and the way we deal with business just the way the internet did.
segments.zh: 其中许多**是合理的，因为AI将像互联网一样改变生活和商业方式。

segments.en: Whether the internet had a bubble or not at some point in time is something that you can say maybe it did.
segments.zh: 互联网当年是否出现过泡沫？或许有。

segments.en: AI could have a little bubble at some point but right now I think the markets are still fully resolved that AI will be a pretty good thing to invest in.
segments.zh: AI未来也可能出现小泡沫，但目前市场普遍认为AI是值得**的领域。

segments.en: And there may be at some point in time there may be some slight reduction in the values but generally AI is here to stay and enormous amounts of money are going to go into this area.
segments.zh: 未来某个时候，相关资产价值可能会略有回调，但总体而言，人工智能趋势不可逆转，大量资金将持续涌入这一领域。

segments.en: Yeah, something I'm sure that you talked about online and offline with Rick Worcester in your latest episode of Bloomberg Wealth which will get into in a second.
segments.zh: 是的，我相信你在最新一期《彭博财富》节目中与Rick Worcester线上线下都讨论过这个话题，我们稍后会详细展开。
